reason: The README clearly presents an image understanding and rendering utility that converts images into structured spatial text and can render encoded descriptions into visual outputs through MCP, CLI, and agent integrations.

summaries.zh: 将图片发送至配置的视觉模型并转换为结构化空间文字，同时支持将编码描述或像素数据渲染为 SVG、PNG 或 HTML。
summaries.en: Analyzes images with a configured vision model to produce structured spatial text and renders encoded descriptions or pixel data as SVG, PNG, or HTML.

capabilities: Analyzes local or remote images through a configured vision-model API
Produces structured spatial text descriptions of image contents
Renders structured descriptions or pixel data into SVG, PNG, or HTML outputs
Exposes image analysis and rendering through MCP, CLI, and agent extension interfaces
Reads API configuration and credentials from documented files or environment variables
